name: print-social-orange-threads-poster-with-vertical-stripes-and-circle
title: Orange poster with a giant black 'threads' over white vertical stripes and a solid circle of text
whatItIs: A poster in orange with a central band of thin white vertical stripes, a huge black lowercase 'threads' cutting across them, and a solid orange circle interrupting the stripes with two small columns of text. Small text repeats in the four corners on a black frame.
whatItMeans: Bold and rhythmic; stripes are literal threads and the circle a moment of pause.
techniques: Use stripes to illustrate the word.
Interrupt the pattern with a solid circle for text.
Set one giant lowercase word across the top.
Repeat small text in all corners.

vocabulary.definition: A band of repeated thin lines.
A solid circle breaking a pattern.
Small copy set in all four corners.
A pattern that visualises the topic.
